facts.fact: The education minister says in a November 2025 interview that the ministry, through its GOSE and SMIS platforms, now has reliable data to detect pupils in difficulty before they drop out, and that more than 3,000 pupils have been supported through the system; he does not say who enters the data, how often, or at which school levels.

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale et de la Formation Professionnelle
systems.tiers: not stated; used by the ministry to identify individual pupils at risk

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale et de la Formation Professionnelle
systems.tiers: more than 60 pilot schools, for school self-evaluation

note: Classed emis because the document says the platforms identify individual pupils; it does not state that schools enter records during the year, so the parent should weigh the class.
